description: Record dedupe (people/companies) — Find and merge duplicate contacts, customers, leads or vendors in a CSV, offline. Auto-detects email, phone, name (or first/last), company, address, zip and city columns (override with columns=email:Work Email,name:Full Name). Exact matches on normalized email (case, Gmail dots and +tags ignored) or phone (formatting and leading 1 ignored) are HIGH confidence; fuzzy matches use Jaro-Winkler on names with titles/suffixes removed, swapped 'Last, First' order and initials (J. Smith vs John Smith), or company names with Inc/LLC/Ltd/Corp removed, and must be backed by the same zip, address, city, company or email domain; pairs whose emails or phones conflict are reported as near misses instead of merged. Returns duplicate groups with rows, reasons, confidence, conflicting values and a merged record (most complete row with gaps filled), plus the deduplicated CSV. threshold= 0.8-0.99 (default 0.92). Up to 5,000 rows. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
